page.notes: Several entries are garbled in the scan and are marked [?]: "Mblochafgu", "init-quisquam", "procerum", "a.218.a 5.b", "Murũmemorabilis ... cætrudtus", "Niihia", "Nobiliũ in laco.m.conspiratio" and "Robufiæ". The "INDEX." head is the title of the index. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible in this part. Several entries are faint or broken at the scan edge, notably the first lines at the top, the Ouēs entry, the Osrima and Osiualdus entries and parts of the Patricius entries; doubtful readings are marked [?] or should be checked against the scan. Page references are copied as printed, including the irregular dots and commas. Entries at the top are cut off, so the first line is a fragment. Several lines in the Pontificis entry are damaged and garbled on the scan; the marked words are uncertain or illegible. The numbers after many entries are only partly legible and are copied as far as they can be read.
